text: IF we attach a global-count auxiliary head that pools the fine feature map and the exemplar mean and adds a scaled soft-count bias onto the density output IN the CountingHead decoder of the frozen DINOv3-ConvNeXt-Tiny champion THEN final val MAE on FSC147 is at least 0.30 lower than the plain decoder BECAUSE a global count anchor disambiguates scale between sparse and dense scenes, an ambiguity that per-box exemplars cannot represent, so the decoder avoids systematic undercount. DISPROVED IF final val MAE is not at least 0.30 lower than the plain decoder

IF we add a coarse multi-scale exemplar summary that pools each exemplar ROI at a second scales and additively fuses its pooled summary into the exemplar token before the condenser IN the ExemplarEncoder of the N0054 interface THEN final val MAE improves by at least 0.30 over the single-scale exemplar BECAUSE exemplar appearance is scale-invariant only when the encoder sees both fine and coarse views, so cross-scale exemplar contrast helps the condenser separate objects from backgrounds. DISPROVED IF final val MAE does not improve by at least 0.30 over the single-scale exemplar

IF we read the frozen backbone at the intermediate hidden states stages 2 and 3 instead of the final stage IN the Backbone of the champion counter THEN final val MAE is at least 1.00 lower than the final-layer readout BECAUSE intermediate features of the frozen ConvNeXt carry the fine-grained and detection-like semantics needed for count supervision that later global-context stages wash out, matching the paper increasing-depth prior on readout choice. DISPROVED IF final val MAE is not at least 1.00 lower than the final-layer readout

IF we consume exemplar tokens with a cross-attention condenser, a learned multi-head-attention plus feed-forward consumer, instead of a simpler aggregation operator IN the Condenser of the CountingHead THEN final val MAE is at least 0.40 lower than the best non-attention aggregator BECAUSE learned soft attention over exemplars lets each density location attend to the most scale- and appearance-relevant prototypes, which fixed operators cannot express, so localization error falls. DISPROVED IF final val MAE improves by less than 0.40 over the best non-attention aggregator

IF we release the backbone for training with a differential lower learning rate IN the Backbone regime of the champion counter THEN final val MAE is at least 1.00 worse than the fully frozen champion BECAUSE the frozen intermediate readout is the load-bearing interface and unfreezing it destabilizes the features that every head component is anchored to, which the earlier unfreeze probes confirmed. DISPROVED IF the unfrozen run ends within 1.00 of the frozen champion

IF we add a dilated-context branch that runs a parallel dilated depthwise convolution over the fine feature map IN the FineFuser of the CountingHead THEN final val MAE is at least 0.40 worse than with the branch absent BECAUSE dilated context reuses the same exemplar-aligned evidence at a coarser scale, adding redundant cues that the density decoder then double-counts, which raises false positives in dense regions. DISPROVED IF val MAE with the branch is not at least 0.40 worse than without it

IF we read the backbone density-relevant features from its final layer only instead of the intermediate stages 2 and 3 IN the Backbone readout of the champion counter THEN final val MAE is at least 1.00 worse than the intermediate readout BECAUSE final-layer features collapse high-frequency detail needed for precise localization while intermediate ones retain it, and the frozen network never adapts that choice back, so count and localization both degrade. DISPROVED IF val MAE with the final-layer readout is within 1.00 of the intermediate readout

IF we feed the density decoder extra spatial summaries such as key, fine, and max pooling statistics or a regional count auxiliary IN the CountingHead of the champion counter THEN final val MAE is at least 0.40 worse than the decoder fed only the fused fine feature and condensed exemplar tokens BECAUSE extra summaries duplicate the same counting evidence under different pooling views, inflating parameter budget and giving the decoder redundant channels that worsen generalization on unseen densities. DISPROVED IF val MAE with the extra summaries is not at least 0.40 worse than without them

text: IF we pool the fine feature map globally and emit one scalar gating coefficient that reweights the exemplar tokens per feature channel IN the Condenser of the CountingHead THEN final val MAE improves by at least 0.30 over the unconditional condenser BECAUSE a per-exemplar channel-gain lets the decoder express count-dependent attention that a fixed affine readout cannot, steering the condenser toward scale-consistent exemplar weights. DISPROVED IF val MAE is not at least 0.30 lower than the unconditional condenser

note: Seeded same-protocol rerun: parent N0001 21.459 vs gated child 22.608 -> D=-1.149, far below the +0.30 bar. Mechanism-fidelity failure: image-global per-channel gate cannot express per-exemplar steering claimed in BECAUSE. Gate hurt by ~1.15 MAE.

text: IF we compute a per-exemplar reliability gate as sigmoid of a linear read-out of each exemplar token and rescale that exemplar embedding before it enters the condenser cross-attention IN the CountingHead of the champion counter THEN final val MAE is at least 0.30 lower than the champion without any exemplar gating BECAUSE a gate that varies between exemplars of the same image lets the condenser down-weight a weakly-localized prototype whose ROI features are dominated by background or occlusion, so attention concentrates on trustworthy prototypes and count error on mixed-quality exemplar scenes falls, while a fixed or image-global gate cannot make this per-exemplar choice. DISPROVED IF final val MAE is not at least 0.30 lower than the champion with the gate removed

IF we keep the same 33,024-parameter exemplar channel gate that the gated child tests but sever its conditioning by feeding the gate a fixed frozen random vector of the same shape instead of the pooled fine features IN the CountingHead of the gated champion THEN final val MAE is at least 0.30 worse than the content-conditioned gate result of 22.608 BECAUSE an equal-capacity gate whose input carries no information can only absorb into the condenser projections as a constant rescale, so if it reproduces the conditioned gate score then the gate benefit is inert capacity not feature conditioning, and the two runs separate mechanism from padding. DISPROVED IF final val MAE with the frozen-random gate is within 0.30 of the content-conditioned gate result of 22.608

note: Joint test with H0009 on champion lineage: child 23.382 vs seeded parent 21.459 = D=-1.923 vs +0.30 bar. Per-exemplar gate + channel gate together far worse; individual attribution confounded (joint set).
Second trajectory test (N0001->N0004, Q_t-booked): 23.382 vs 21.459 = -1.923 vs +0.30 bar -> disproved again, joint with H0010.

text: IF we condition the condenser cross-attention temperature on the image global count prior computed by a small MLP over the pooled fine feature and the mean exemplar embedding so that dense scenes attend broadly over prototypes and sparse scenes attend sharply IN the Condenser of the CountingHead THEN final val MAE is at least 0.40 lower than the fixed-temperature condenser BECAUSE a single attention temperature cannot serve both crowd regimes, sharp attention overweights the one best-matching prototype and undercounts dense clusters while flat attention spreads mass over irrelevant prototypes and overcounts sparse scenes, so a count-scaled temperature reduces error on both tails that the fixed condenser leaves uncorrected. DISPROVED IF final val MAE is not at least 0.40 lower than the champion with the fixed-temperature condenser

IF we replace the fixed bilinear upsampling that brings the coarse backbone readout to the fused resolution with a learned depth-to-space subpixel block inside the FineFuser IN the FineFuser of the CountingHead THEN final val MAE is at least 0.30 lower than with bilinear upsampling BECAUSE a fixed bilinear kernel low-pass-filters the coarse stage and smears each density head support, while a learned per-channel subpixel upsample preserves the detail that the count sum integrates and tightens localization around density peaks without changing the feature interface or adding meaningful parameters. DISPROVED IF final val MAE is not at least 0.30 lower than with bilinear upsampling

text: IF we bolt a similarity-aware enhancement block onto the fused fine feature map that projects the fine map and the exemplar tokens into a shared score space, softmax-normalizes each query-exemplar similarity map jointly across the exemplar axis and the spatial axis, and adds a similarity-weighted mix of value-projected exemplar tokens back onto every spatial location as a residual before the map enters the condenser IN the CountingHead of the champion counter THEN final val MAE is at least 0.30 lower than the champion without the enhancement BECAUSE the condenser gives every location the same exemplar attention distribution, so background patches that weakly match any prototype still pass feature evidence to the density head, while a dual-normalized similarity map selects which prototype matches at each location and sharpens the locations where that prototype matches, injecting the match decision into the feature the decoder sums and leaving the residual features untouched where no prototype matches, which cuts false-positive density on clutter. DISPROVED IF final val MAE is not at least 0.30 lower than the champion N0001 seed of 21.459, that is, final val MAE is above 21.159

IF we add a small exemplar-conditioned gating MLP that maps each exemplar embedding to its own per-channel weight vector and multiplies that vector into the channels of that exemplar's token before the token enters the condenser cross-attention IN the CountingHead of the champion counter THEN final val MAE is at least 0.30 lower than the champion without the gate BECAUSE every exemplar token is a pooled ROI whose channels mix object appearance with that box's background and illumination, and one fixed or image-global gate cannot choose a different channel subspace for each exemplar, so a per-exemplar channel mask lets the condenser matching keys carry the object-bearing channels of that specific prototype and down-weight the context channels, which reduces both missed matches for unusual exemplars and false matches on textured background. DISPROVED IF final val MAE is not at least 0.30 lower than the champion N0001 seed of 21.459, that is, final val MAE is above 21.159
